elements.label: Font File
elements.description: Font file name, including the extension. The file must exist in assets/default_assets/fonts/.

elements.label: Auto Fit Text To Source
elements.description: Shrink the text automatically so it always fits inside the browser source, however odd the source size is. Turn this off to always draw at exactly Max Font Size and let long text overflow.

elements.label: Max Font Size
elements.description: Largest size the text is allowed to be, in pixels. With Auto Fit on this is the starting point and the text only ever scales down from here; with Auto Fit off it is the exact size used.

elements.label: Min Font Size
elements.description: Smallest size Auto Fit is allowed to shrink to. If the text still does not fit at this size it will be clipped, so make the OBS source bigger instead of lowering this too far.

elements.label: Text Wrapping
elements.description: wrap = long text breaks onto multiple lines and then shrinks to fit the source height. nowrap = text always stays on one line and shrinks to fit the source width.

elements.label: Font Weight
elements.description: Thickness of the text. Some font files only contain one weight, in which case this has no visible effect.

elements.label: Font Color
elements.description: Color of the text.

elements.label: Text Shadow
elements.description: CSS text-shadow value, e.g. '2px 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.8)'. Use 'none' for no shadow. A shadow keeps text readable over busy gameplay.

elements.label: Line Height
elements.description: Spacing between lines, as a multiple of the font size. Only visible when Text Wrapping is set to wrap and the text is long enough to use more than one line.

elements.label: Horizontal Alignment
elements.description: Where the text sits across the width of the source. flex-start = left, center = center, flex-end = right.

elements.label: Vertical Alignment
elements.description: Where the text sits down the height of the source. flex-start = top, center = middle, flex-end = bottom.

elements.label: Edge Padding
elements.description: Blank margin in pixels kept clear inside every edge of the source. Auto Fit treats this as unusable space, so raising it makes the text smaller.

elements.label: Background Color
elements.description: Fills the whole browser source behind the text. Leave transparent for a text-only overlay.

elements.label: Border Width
elements.description: Border drawn around the outside edge of the browser source, in pixels. Set to 0 for no border.

elements.label: Border Color
elements.description: Color of the border. Only visible when Border Width is above 0.

elements.label: Corner Radius
elements.description: Rounds the corners of the background and border, in pixels. Has no effect while the background is transparent and the border width is 0.

elements.label: Category Data Source
elements.description: How the current category is kept up to date. api_and_eventsub (recommended) reads the Twitch API on load and on a timer AND accepts live push updates. eventsub_only relies entirely on live push updates, so it will not fill in on a source refresh. api_only ignores push updates and relies on the timer.

elements.label: API Refresh Interval (seconds)
elements.description: How often to re-read the category from the Twitch API. This is a safety net that catches changes if live push updates stop arriving. Set to 0 to only read on source load and on Refresh Category. Values below 15 are treated as 15. Ignored when Data Source is eventsub_only.

elements.label: Show Category
elements.description: On: display your live Twitch category. Off: display the Custom Title text instead. The Show Category switch in Source Controls changes this same setting while you stream.

elements.label: Custom Title
elements.description: Text shown while Show Category is off. Leave empty for a blank overlay. Can also be typed live from Source Controls.

elements.label: Category Prefix
elements.description: Text placed before the category name, e.g. 'Now playing: '. Only used while Show Category is on.

elements.label: Category Suffix
elements.description: Text placed after the category name. Only used while Show Category is on.

elements.label: Enable Animations
elements.description: Animate the change when the category updates. Custom titles always change instantly so typing is never dropped.

elements.label: Transition Duration
elements.description: How long a text change animation takes, in seconds.

elements.label: Enable Pulse Effect
elements.description: Continuously fade the text in and out.

elements.label: Pulse Speed
elements.description: Length of one full pulse cycle, in seconds. Only used when Enable Pulse Effect is on.

elements.label: Pulse Opacity
elements.description: How faint the text gets at the dimmest point of the pulse, and the opacity used mid fade when the wipe animation is off.

elements.label: Enable Glow Effect
elements.description: Add a colored glow around the text, on top of the Text Shadow.

elements.label: Glow Color
elements.description: Color of the glow. Only used when Enable Glow Effect is on.

elements.label: Enable Wipe Animation
elements.description: Slide the old text out and the new text in when the category changes, instead of a simple fade. Requires Enable Animations.

elements.label: Wipe Direction
elements.description: Direction the text slides during the wipe animation.

elements.label: Wipe Easing Strength
elements.description: Shape of the wipe acceleration curve. 0.1 is nearly linear, 1.0 is dramatic.

elements.label: Show Category
elements.description: Display your live Twitch category on stream. Turn off to show the custom title instead. This choice is saved, so it survives a source refresh.

elements.label: Custom Title
elements.description: Text shown while Show Category is off. Turn Show Category off to display it.

elements.label: Clear Custom Title
elements.description: Clear the custom title and turn Show Category back on.

elements.label: Refresh Category
elements.description: Re-read the current category from Twitch right now.

elements.label: Title Text
elements.description: The title text to display. Use {{placeholder}} for dynamic content.

elements.label: Set as Custom Title
elements.description: If enabled, this will override automatic title updates

elements.label: Display Duration (seconds)
elements.description: How long to display this title before reverting (0 = permanent)
